port_summary: Preserve all upstream declaration names and theorem statements.
Migrate module visibility and source-reference metadata to the Lean 4.35 module system.
Expose the partition/tableau and hook-product definitions needed by consumers.
Replace deprecated if/dif lemma spellings and normalize dependent conditionals in the tableau branching inverse proof.
Use a tactic proof for the exported definitional-compatibility theorem.
Add two module docstrings, preserve upstream namespace API with its duplicate-namespace linter disabled locally, and fix unused-binder/style warnings.
